name: Subscriber failure is isolated and reported after flush

input.source_text: class B {} module M { public fun run() -> Array { Revision.subscribe({ |event| raise :bad }); Revision.subscribe({ |event| :ok }); B.open() { |t| :commit }; Revision.flush(); Revision.event_errors() } } M.run()

applicability.reason: The error channel records a failing subscriber without rolling back the commit.
